resources.string: During your chosen protection period, returns Home from blocked gambling apps, VPN apps, VPN install pages and the Settings screens that would switch SafeNest off.

After your separate consent, SafeNest reads the foreground app package ID and the labels of Android Settings, app-installer and Play Store screens only. It returns Home when you open a blocked gambling app or a VPN app, when a VPN app install page is shown, and when a Settings screen would uninstall, force-stop or disable SafeNest or its VPN during an active protection period you chose and paid for. SafeNest never reads browser pages, messages, passwords, keyboard input or notification content, and nothing it observes is recorded or uploaded. Website filtering uses the separate local DNS service. There is no in-app pause during the finite commitment; it ends automatically at expiry, and Android Safe Mode, a factory reset or a computer can still remove the app.
